Subject: SIG questionnaire and evidence intake for platform assessment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our SIG Core + SOC2-lite questionnaire (we annotated a few items that are high-priority for procurement). We need a control mapping and at least the primary evidence packets for the following buckets by next Thursday: authentication, key management, incident response, and network segmentation.

Questions we have up front:
- Can you confirm whether your SOC 2 report includes encryption key lifecycle details (key generation/rotation/retirement)?
- Do you have a system architecture diagram showing VPC boundaries and data flow for the hosted API?

Deliverables we expect: control mapping CSV, PDF evidence (reports, diagrams), and a short statement of any open control gaps. If helpful, we can run a short intake call to triage scope.

We have a compliance gate on 2027-06-30 for our internal procurement review — would you be able to commit to an evidence pickup by 2027-06-24?

Thanks,
Daniel Park
SecurityFabric — Sr. Procurement Manager

Attachments: securityfabric_SIG_core_annotated.xlsx (questionnaire), procurement-timeline.pdf (notes)
